d: A homicidal pizza chain manager and his twisted girlfriend launch a reign of terror, using her charms to lure new victims into their deadly game of revenge.
In 1991, Phillip and Nancy Garrido kidnap 11-year-old Jaycee Dugard, keeping her as a sex slave. Their sick world collapses in 2009 when investigators finally suspect foul play.
Desperate for drug money, two lovers rob jewelry stores during the 2004 holiday season. Their spree escalates into a murderous rampage, leaving investigators scrambling to stop them.
Pool hall hustler Donald Fish is seduced by two violent women who steal his money. Investigators race against time to catch the duo before they strike again.
Obsessed with sex and money, Catherina Voss hires a hitman to kill her husband, Navy Ensign Cory Voss. As she awaits the insurance payout, police uncover dark secrets and lies.

In a Texas college town, 20-year-old freshman Jenna Verhaalen is brutally strangled to death in her off-campus apartment. And amid signs of a violent struggle, it’s a lockbox and DNA from the crime scene that ultimately lead detectives to her killer.

In a mysterious homicide-by-poison, New York detectives receive two anonymous letters that point the finger at the victim’s son. But as they dig deeper, they uncover a twisted motive and a nearly perfect crime.

When the body of a cab driver is discovered in the trunk of his car, Oklahoma detectives are soon convinced they’ve cracked the case. But it will take more investiagting to determine who lured Rafael Hernandez to his death.

In 1954, the fairy-tale life of Dr. Sam Sheppard shattered with the bludgeoning death of his pregnant wife Marilyn. Though Sam claimed a bushy-haired intruder injured him, the doctor was charged with murder.
In 1999, for only the second time in history, a President of the United States went through trial before the Senate after being impeached by the House of Representatives.
Shannon Mohr was killed by her husband David Davis, who took out huge insurance policies on her within two months of their marriage.
Story of Thomas Capano, the powerful former Delaware prosecutor who was sentenced to death for the murder of his ex-lover.

The case of Robert Diaz, a hospital worker accused of killing 12 patients by giving them an overdose of the common heart-regulating drug lidocaine. Diaz is on San Quentin's death row for his crimes but maintains his innocence.

The shocking saga of Barbara Stager, a suburban mom who appeared to be a devoted wife and mother, but whose secret extramarital affairs and expensive taste led her to murder her first and second husbands.
In 1997, two sword-obsessed dropouts murder a family in Bellevue, Washington, driven by one’s grudge and the other’s blind loyalty. Police race to stop them.
In 1978, two violent inmates bond over shared sadistic fantasies. Once released, they unleash a reign of terror across Southern California, targeting innocent women.
In 1996, Madison, GA, police investigate an elderly woman’s murder, uncovering ruthless killers John Esposito and Alicia Woodward. As bodies pile up, a chilling truth emerges.
In 2000, Devon Guzman is found with her throat slashed. Police unravel a tangled web of jealousy and deceit, exposing a love triangle with deadly consequences.
In 1995, a pregnant woman is murdered, her unborn baby ripped from her womb. Suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend and a childless couple desperate for a family.
In 1995, an Oklahoma couple’s drug-fueled crime spree leaves victims across the South. Hollywood producers face lawsuits after the killers cite “Natural Born Killers” as inspiration.
